target.title: fix(auto-reply): retry reply-session init CAS conflicts with backoff
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #102400.

Reply-session initialization retried a lost optimistic-concurrency commit exactly **once, with zero delay**, inside the session-store writer lane. When another writer (gateway restart recovery, a concurrent dashboard tab, an active reply run) was mid-commit on the same session key, both attempts lost the revision CAS within milliseconds and `reply session initialization conflicted for <sessionKey>` escaped to the caller — silently dropping the inbound event on the webchat/Slack/heartbeat paths, while the Telegram poller already classified the same error as retryable.

This PR fixes the conflict at the `initSessionState` layer so **all** inbound paths benefit, instead of wiring spool/re-enqueue logic into each channel separately:

- New typed `ReplySessionInitConflictError` thrown at the CAS-failure site (message shape preserved — the Telegram poller regex-matches it).
- New `runWithSessionInitConflictRetry` helper: up to 5 attempts with jittered exponential backoff (250ms → 4s cap), wrapping the **unlocked** outer attempt.
- `initSessionState` retries through the helper, honoring the inbound abort signal.

## Design notes

- **Backoff never holds the writer lane.** The retry sleeps outside `runExclusiveSessionStoreWrite`; sleeping inside the locked attempt would stall every other writer on the store. Each retry re-runs the full attempt with a fresh snapshot.
- The existing single in-lock stale-snapshot fast retry is kept as-is; the typed error is only thrown when that fast path also loses.
- Non-conflict errors and aborted signals are rethrown immediately (no retry).

## Field validation

Running the equivalent backoff patch on a production gateway (v2026.6.11, macOS arm64) that previously reproduced this twice in one evening via restart-recovery racing dashboard reply init: zero init-conflict errors since, including across subsequent gateway restarts (see https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102400#issuecomment-4953134648).

## Test plan

- [x] New unit tests: `src/auto-reply/reply/session.init-conflict-retry.test.ts` (7 tests — success passthrough, retry-then-succeed, exhaustion rethrow, custom maxAttempts, non-conflict errors not retried, abort-signal bail, capped/jittered backoff schedule)
- [x] Existing suites pass: `session.test.ts`, `session.heartbeat-no-reset.test.ts`, `session-hooks-context.test.ts` (156 tests)
- [x] `tsgo:core` typecheck clean
- [x] `lint` (oxlint) clean, `oxfmt` applied
